Covering every equine discipline while showcasing Ocala/Marion County, Florida—and beyond.

Launched in 2018, our regular video content highlights all aspects of the horse industry while promoting Ocala/Marion County, proudly trademarked as the Horse Capital of the World®. This Central Florida region is home to more horses than anywhere else in the United States.
